title: Min-Max Phase 2: Peak Physique

general.name: Light cardio
general.detail: 5-10 minutes on treadmill, stairmaster, elliptical or bike

specific.text: Ca. 50% af arbejdsvægten, 6–10 reps. Se programmets antal opvarmningssæt.
Set 1: ~50% for 6-10 reps. Set 2: ~70% for 4-6 reps

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.cue: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Machine Lat Pullover
exercises.cue: Smooth, controlled reps. Feel a deep stretch in your lats at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Machine Lat Pullover (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: Smooth, controlled reps. Feel a deep stretch in your lats at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.cue: Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.cue: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Incline DB Y-Raise
exercises.cue: Use a 30° incline bench (back against the bench) and lift the weight up and out in a Y shape.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Cheat Curl
exercises.cue: Use some momentum to get the weight up, but be sure to control the weight on the way down!

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.cue: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative. Pause for 1 second in the stretch part of each rep.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.cue: Use a controlled negative (don't free fall) and then explode on the positive.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat (using straps can help here).

exercises.name: Leg Extension (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat (using straps can help here).

exercises.name: DB Walking Lunge
exercises.cue: Take medium strides. Minimize contribution from the back leg

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.cue: Perform Glute Kickbacks if you want to focus on your glutes. Perform 45° Hyperextension if you want to focus more on your lower back and hamstrings.

days.name: Rest Day
days.note: 1–2 hviledage efter Lower. Tilpas placeringen til din uge.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: DB Bench Press
exercises.cue: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: DB Bench Press (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat (using straps can help here).

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Resist the negative on every rep and avoid pausing at the bottom

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: Resist the negative on every rep and avoid pausing at the bottom

exercises.name: Cable Flye
exercises.cue: Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown
exercises.cue: You can use a rope or bar attachment for these, whichever you find more comfortable.

exercises.name: Pull-Up (Wide Grip)
exercises.cue: Slow 2-3 second negative. Feel your lats pulling apart on the way down.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.cue: Keep your back flat and allow just a slight bend in your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown (high-rep set)
exercises.cue: Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.cue: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.cue: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

exercises.name: 1-Arm Reverse Pec Deck (2nd set)
exercises.cue: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

exercises.name: Preacher Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.cue: Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

guide: Uge 1 er introduktion, uge 7 er deload. Følg RIR-målet ved hvert sæt; målene varierer mellem øvelser og uger.
RIR er gentagelser i reserve: 0 = ingen tilbage, 1 = én tilbage, 2 = to tilbage.
Når alle arbejdssæt når toppen af rep-intervallet, øges vægten næste gang. Hvis springet er for stort, behold vægten og øg reps lidt.
S1 er et superset: curl → skull crusher → 30–60 sekunders pause. Gentag parret.
Ekstra teknikker vises på de relevante øvelser i uge 8–12. Følg markeringen ved sættet.
Høje reps er en separat del af samme øvelse med lettere vægt. Vægtene huskes separat.
Arms / Delts er valgfrit og tæller ikke med i hovedprogrammets fremgang. Der er ikke leveret en særskilt progression til armdagen.
